description.text: Welcome to the home of technology innovation and entrepreneurship at the USC Viterbi School of Engineering! USC Viterbi has been the proud base of innovation for many years. Today we are linked closely with Silicon Beach but our innovations have transformed multiple industries.

targetApplicants.text: "MEPC was a truly challenging new experience that helped push me past my knowledge as an engineer, and really take my first steps as an entrepreneur."

sources.quote: From Robotron to $2.3 Billion: How William Wang Is Paying It Forward at USC Viterbi A transformational $10 million gift from the Vizio founder and his wife creates the William Wang Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship Hub - and may establish a new model for engineering entrepreneurship nationwide. Learn More (opens in a new tab) WE ARE THE William W. Wang TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP hub. Explore Our COMPETITIONS PROGRAMS COURSES EVENTS & ACTIVITIES Browse our event calendar to see upcoming competitions, workshops, networking events, and more. See What's Happening This Week View Event Calendar (opens in a new tab) "This [workshop] has been the single, most valuable hour I've ever spent at USC. I've learned so much about what it takes to launch a company [...]" "As an undergrad, I actually did a business degree with an entrepreneurship concentration. That was good, but this competition took me from theoretical knowledge to actually launching a venture. This single program could have easily been a minor in entrepreneurship, and in fact is likely more valuable than any course offerings we have here at USC."
